cards.meaning: hearing — a formal session where a court or body listens to testimony or argument before deciding
cards.example: May pagdinig na magaganap tungkol sa kayamanan ni Vice President Duterte.
cards.exampleMeaning: There will be a hearing about VP Duterte's wealth.
cards.note: Legal/formal term for an official session with a record and consequences — distinct from 'usapan' (a casual conversation), which carries no institutional weight. Standard word for a court or Senate proceeding.
cards.tiesTo: Senate impeachment court hearing four retired chief justices as amici curiae on the conviction-vote threshold

cards.meaning: wealth/fortune — the full value of a person's accumulated assets, especially in a formal or legal context
cards.example: Susuriin ng Senado ang kayamanan ni VP Duterte pabalik hanggang sa panahong lokal siyang opisyal sa Davao.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Senate will examine VP Duterte's wealth going back to when she was a local official in Davao.
cards.note: More formal than its root 'yaman' — used in legal/financial contexts when assessing an official's total accumulated assets, e.g. establishing a wealth baseline in a graft or impeachment inquiry.
cards.tiesTo: Senate impeachment court's new probe into VP Duterte's wealth baseline

cards.meaning: gray area — a space that is neither clearly legal/illegal nor clearly regulated/unregulated
cards.example: 这些跨境投资平台一直处于监管的灰色地带。
cards.examplePinyin: Zhèxiē kuàjìng tóuzī píngtái yīzhí chǔyú jiānguǎn de huīsè dìdài.
cards.exampleMeaning: These cross-border investment platforms have long existed in a regulatory gray area.
cards.note: Abstract collocation used in both formal financial reporting and everyday speech for something technically unaddressed by clear rules — distinct from openly illegal activity.
cards.tiesTo: Hong Kong gray-market investment platforms (ZD Group, Star Bridge Capital) collapsing after channeling mainland money offshore

cards.meaning: because of X, therefore Y — a formal causal connective pair, more written/formal than 因为…所以…
cards.example: 由于境内理财回报持续偏低,因此大量资金转向了境外的灰色地带产品。
cards.examplePinyin: Yóuyú jìngnèi lǐcái huíbào chíxù piāndī, yīncǐ dàliàng zījīn zhuǎnxiàng le jìngwài de huīsè dìdài chǎnpǐn.
cards.exampleMeaning: Because domestic investment returns have stayed low, large sums of money have shifted toward offshore gray-area products.
cards.note: 书面语/formal register connective, typical of an economic-analysis opening line rather than casual speech — pairs naturally with 灰色地带 when explaining why capital moves toward under-regulated products.
cards.tiesTo: Weak domestic returns pushing mainland money toward Hong Kong's gray-market investment platforms
